# init_mat! {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
init_mat!(dgp, dist_error, mat)
```
Initialize the data matrix `mat` in-place for a spatial DGP by setting its first row(s) and column(s) to the marginal mean of the process. Methods exist for [`SAR11`](SAR11.qmd), [`SINAR11`](SINAR11.qmd) (mean rounded to an integer), and [`SAR22`](SAR22.qmd) (first two rows/columns).
 
  * `dgp`: spatial DGP ([`SAR11`](SAR11.qmd), [`SINAR11`](SINAR11.qmd), or [`SAR22`](SAR22.qmd)).
  * `dist_error`: innovation (error) distribution of the process.
  * `mat`: data matrix to initialize.


:::
